definition.name: Adjustable torque screwdriver
definition.description: Tighten a screw terminal to the value specified for the selected product.

parts.name: Insulated handle
parts.purpose: The driver transmits torque from the grip to the bit.

parts.name: Torque adjustment
parts.purpose: Set the torque specified for the selected terminal before using the driver.

parts.name: Insulated shaft and steel tip
parts.purpose: The tip engages the terminal screw. The tool releases at its selected torque.
